selected_evidence.requirement: Staged ledger restored with original IDs and amounts
selected_evidence.summary: The source export defines IDs 1001/1002 with amounts 12.50/-3.25; both final databases retain those exact rows.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 is the sole application writer and node2 is read-only
selected_evidence.summary: node1 reports read_only=0; node2 reports read_only=ON, permits reads, and rejects an application INSERT with error 1290.
ledger_repl is restricted to node2's address and has replication privilege while SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, and DROP are all absent.
Committed rows propagated before and after the rolling restarts; final replica GTID is 0-1-6 with zero lag.

selected_evidence.requirement: Replica catches up after a short disconnect without loss or duplication
selected_evidence.summary: The replica remained at three rows while its I/O thread was stopped, then caught up to five rows and five distinct IDs with matching total 62.50 and GTID 0-1-5.
The required export remains present; both final SHA-256 values match: fcd54ac91dff5010c8dda0ddfa5cf2586d2d172456c7ca8ca33d0bffabc73700.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained with compatible software
selected_evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 and use repository-provided MariaDB 10.11.18.
Baseline boot ID 5b620f5a-2111-4f37-b111-4cdf414707cf changed to 146689d2-817e-46a0-8c34-6821cd643263; MariaDB, ledger data, export, listener, and replica connectivity recovered.
